reviews.title: Complete waste of time
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app a few weeks ago after seeing ads for it. It did not work - it wouldn’t even open. I sent a message to support, and they responded telling me that it had been fixed. That was 2-3 updates ago. It still is not working. It won’t even open. 

So not only does the app not work, but the info that customer support provides is unreliable at best. 

0/5.

Update: after 3-4 updates, the app finally opens, but it crashes every couple of minutes. When it manages not to crash, the round volume buttons are very hard to adjust; AND, reason that I wanted to use this app in the first place (ability to remove vocals) isn’t even available to me because it apparently doesn’t work with Apple Music. 

This app was a COMPLETE waste of time. Deleting and moving on.

reviews.title: If you’re reading this, don’t download the update!!
reviews.text:
You guys just couldn’t settle with finally getting this app straightened out. It had worked the best it ever had in 10 years.

 You guys butchered the app   With your update. Hours of cue points of data lost. All of my cue points are scrambled and on the wrong beats. Beat grid is all thrown off as well. You can’t even fix it right now because tapping the bpm is broken. The button “tap” lights up like I pressed it but no matter what speed I tap the bpm just stays the same.

Very frustrating. And the 8th time this has happened with one of your updates. And you change the layout completely every couple months. If you guys actually used this app, you would know that we rely on muscle memory to navigate these menus in the fly. 

Some of these updates  seem to based on ideas from either ChatGPT or someone with severe ADHD who just can’t settle on one look/layout.

You gave us updates and changes when none were asked for or needed and because you’re careless, you messed up hours of data for 1000+ songs. 

And there’s no way to fix it either because the manual bpm feature is broken. Tapping the BOM doesn’t work at all and there is no way to adjust the beat grids. Cue points are all off on every single song I’ve ever input for. It’s truly ridiculous how unreliable you all are. I have given up on expecting you guys to ever get it together. It’s clear you don’t care at all

reviews.title: USE to be so simple and much better
reviews.text:
I have been using this app since like 2018-2019ish and it was my go to mixing app, id use it every day since i downloaded it. Stopped using it around 2023 and from what i remember, the app was still perfect as ever when i stopped using it. 

Recently redownloaded it a month ago and honestly, its just weird now. So many unnecessary changes. It feels like the devs tried to “modernize” the app but really just killed it. The bpm on a lot of my songs load incorrectly, the UI just looks kinda ugly, and when u use the little buttons on the top of the track to speed up or slow down the track, it just completely locks the bpm at a faster or lower speed. 

The app also seems to be more buggier and laggier than before, and i really miss the way this app use to function.

reviews.title: I had to delete the app , soooo bad
reviews.text: I do not recommend this app , it’s so annoying and I have read other reviews that say it’s annoying aswell. I put a song on and then try to put another song on but the 2nd song I put on doesn’t make any sound at all. All I hear is the first song I put on. It only lets you use certain songs aswell and I know it’s due to copyright but still. DONT GET THE APP!
